scope: Independent frozen-source host-codec review. Reviewer did not author this codec. No loader/kernel/native reader/guest handoff review or runtime inference is admitted.
conclusion: No concrete contradiction found. The explicit native layout, strict legacy-form rejection with documented identical-byte limit, pure planner boundary and synthetic assertion-mutation harness support host-codec admission only.

checks.point: Native command line1024, record1152, actual-memory-size at1144
checks.assessment: Constants and both encode/decode paths match the frozen ABI facts. Command capacity includes its terminating NUL: maximum accepted text is1023 ASCII bytes. Revision and version stay2; layout is selected by explicit external profile, not numeric revision inference.

evidence.source_fact: Exact wire size, command span, tail offsets and zero-padding ranges.
Encoder packs fixed little-endian fields and both tails at their native offsets into a zero-initialized local byte buffer.
Decoder requires exact immutable record length, canonical padding and profile, then reads native tail offsets.
Tests assert exact ABI constants/common-prefix bytes and independently check native and legacy tail positions.

checks.point: Legacy short record and nonzero legacy tails are refused
checks.assessment: A736-byte record with608-byte command capacity is always refused by exact length. Padding that legacy synthetic record to1152 with nonzero flags/actual-size at the old offsets fails native canonical command trailing-byte validation. There is no old-tail fallback.

evidence.source_fact: Exact length and first-NUL/all-zero-remainder checks reject the short form and nonzero old tails after a legacy terminator.
Legacy test bytes are independently constructed from explicit synthetic fields only.
Both short and padded nonzero-tail legacy forms refuse; identical zero-tail bytes are explicitly tested and disclosed.

checks.necessary_limit: Zero-tail legacy bytes padded to native length can be byte-identical to canonical native bytes. They cannot be distinguished by a byte parser. Freeze/docs disclose this; a truthful external producer/profile binding is mandatory before integration. A native record may legitimately contain608 or more command bytes. This review does not claim provenance authentication or unconditional detection of padded legacy origin.

checks.point: No saved-capture/device-byte reads or runtime wrong-value/crash claim
checks.assessment: Production imports only dataclasses/hashlib/struct and consumes explicit field dictionaries or caller-supplied payload bytes. It contains no file, transport, device or network reader. Documentation explicitly distinguishes layout facts from any wrong live tail value, crash or allocator diagnosis. Tests read only their local ABI-facts metadata and synthetic/mutated source copies.

evidence.source_fact: Module scope is pure codec/planner and imports only standard dataclass, digest and packing modules.
Encode consumes trusted explicit field values rather than recovering fields from an old capture.
Test values and legacy bytes are generated as synthetic fixtures, not loaded from a device/capture.
Additional256 deterministic full-width roundtrips use seeded random synthetic fields.

checks.review_boundary: No raw saved BootArgs, device bytes, observed addresses, identifiers or lab address were opened or reproduced in this review. The ABI-facts metadata is a layout/provenance input, not captured runtime fields.

checks.point: No target memory writer, RAM allocator, m1n1/kernel change or integration
checks.assessment: Encoding uses ordinary local Python buffers and returns immutable bytes; this is not a claim of zero host heap activity. plan_write only validates supplied numeric bounds/profile/digest metadata and returns a frozen plan. It neither allocates guest/native backing nor invokes a writer/backend. Input allocation review remains an external obligation.

evidence.source_fact: Only a local payload buffer is packed; output is immutable bytes.
Frozen WritePlan contains immutable payload and metadata; metadata() has no writer.
Plan validates exact allocation metadata, unsigned bounds/alignment/full containment and constructs a result; no backend/native operation is accepted.

checks.integration_hold: No loader, m1n1 or kernel correction is supplied. Any future opt-in integration must independently prove final serialization and that no later writer replaces it with the legacy profile.

checks.point: Synthetic test coverage and assertion-killed, syntax-valid mutants
checks.assessment: Existing frozen host suite independently rerun successfully:13 groups,256 seeded roundtrips and11 mutants. Mutation runner compiles each changed Python source, runs its specified test, requires a nonzero assertion FAIL and explicitly rejects ERROR. Syntax/import failures are not counted.

evidence.source_fact: Eleven targeted mutations; compile() precedes execution; FAIL/FAILED required and ERROR forbidden.
Unmodified baseline must pass before mutation execution.

reproduction.temporary_scope: Mutated copies created only in temporary host directories by frozen test runner; original codec/source hashes rechecked unchanged. No native compilation.

Actual field offsets/lengths and local-buffer operations inspected directly; no capture or target bytes used.
